proves.claim: A release removes the same idle item folders as before (a clean one goes; one with only an ignored file, a dirty one and one with unlanded commits stay) while it runs no git worktree list and no worktree status snapshot.

cli.item-folder.release-removes-same-fol.why: Release median is cut by dropping git children that the seat's own files and the claim's own record already answer, so the cut must not change which folders a release removes.
